107488.name: Northwest Technical Institute
107488.notes: NWTI is a state agency; its faculty postings ('NWTI CAREER & TECHNICAL FACULTY I/II') run on the State of Arkansas SuccessFactors board arcareers.arkansas.gov (company=stateofark), which classifies as college_successfactors. Replaces the bogus indeed.com footer link. Note: the fetcher ignores the q= filter and walks the state-wide list, so the title filter does the narrowing.

137120.name: Suncoast Technical College
137120.notes: STC's own Focus School Software job board (linked from sarasotacountyschools.net/o/stcsmc/page/job-board and /page/stc-employment) classifies as college_focus. 0 public postings at verification time (Okaloosa control board returned 118), so the board is live but currently empty. The district's sarasota.k12.fl.us/jobs/Jobpost.exe requires login.

177977.name: State Technical College of Missouri
177977.notes: statetechmo.edu/career-openings/ embeds a Paycor Recruiting (Newton) iframe; the Paycor board (clientId 8a7883c6..., jobs located Linn, MO) classifies as college_paycor and returned 14 postings incl. Automotive Instructor and Surveying Adjunct Instructor.

202648.name: Edison State Community College
202648.notes: Pinpoint career site exposes an RSS feed (jobs.rss) that parses through the rss fetcher (2 adjunct postings matched, incl. 'Adjunct Instructor for Professional & Technical Programs'); replaces the browser-rendered generic scrape of the Pinpoint landing page.

498739.name: Lehigh Career & Technical Institute
498739.notes: Work-at-LCTI page lists openings as 'Job Description' PDF links (HVAC Teacher 2026, Automotive Safety Inspection & Emissions Instructor PT, Heavy Equipment Operations Program Instruction Coordinator, ...); generic fetcher with pdf_links picks the titles from the adjacent headings. The site's WP Job Manager feed (/?feed=job_feed) is a community employer job board, not LCTI's own openings, so it is deliberately not used.
